$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Pass viewer
job: A pass that is an identity card: shown full screen, on its own, for inspection.
useFor: Official cards with photo that are inspected by a person as well as scanned.

allowed: Toolbar · Modal / Default: title, a chip for the season or validity period, close.
forbidden: Actions that leave the pass by accident.

allowed: The official card component as issued: authority marks, photo, name in both scripts, nationality, document number, code, pass number, provider.
forbidden: Restyling or reordering the official card.
A photo that is not the holder.

states.changes: No card; the status and when to expect it.
The last saved card if there is one, a retry (SectionError) and a way to get help.
No code; the status in words.

rules: The card is the only content.
The background never competes with the card.
Authority marks are used as supplied.

allocation.App level: L4 · an artefact. Opened from booking details and from Today when it is needed.
allocation.Band: Band 2; band 1 at a checkpoint. Promoted to P1 at the moment of use.
allocation.Withheld: Each person sees their own card; an organiser sees those of the group.

measure.success: Card opened when needed without retry
measure.guardrails: load failures, support contacts about the card

allocation.Service: Hajj ID · DNA Core · P5 permanent, P1 at its steps.

notes: The card in the example is the library component named "Hajj Landing Update".
example.inTheFlowToday: The card carries "version number %s". A state frame is named "Field".
